get_catalog: fetch the remote model catalog manifest with caching and fallback to disk cache on network failure
get_curated_openrouter_models: retrieve the curated list of OpenRouter model IDs and descriptions from the remote catalog
get_curated_nous_models: retrieve the curated list of Nous Portal model IDs from the remote catalog
reset_cache: clear the in-process model catalog cache to force a fresh fetch on the next call
validate_manifest: validate a model catalog manifest dictionary against the expected schema version and structure
